segments.text: Lycoris, a clone distinctly crafted for Project Yggdrasil, stood out with her unique violet eyes, differing from Nerine. She had an encounter with Rin in the human world before the principal events of the story. Tragically, she met an untimely end. Upon her passing, Lycoris's memories were transferred to Nerine, bequeathing her not just a melodious singing voice but also her profound affection for Rin.

Before her departure, Lycoris shared her tender tale about Rin with Primula, igniting the young girl's interest in him. Although not bound by blood, Primula held Lycoris close to her heart as a sister. In a gesture of affection, Lycoris passed on a treasured stuffed cat she had received from Rin to Primula.

Kikyou is Sia twin sister that was meant to be born with her but she couldn't survive so Sia decided to save Kikyou by allowing Kikyou's soul to reside inside of her own. Kikyou emerges (takes control of Sia's body) when Sia is depressed or when she feels that Sia should be more aggressive to Rin. In Shuffle! Essence+, Kikyou gets an extended ending where she and Sia are able to be separated and thereby co-exist together.
from Wikipedia

Rin, a student at the National Verbena Academy in class 2C, may not be the sharpest tool in the shed academically, but he certainly hits the ball out of the park on the athletic field. Tragically, a bolt from the blue struck eight years earlier when his parents perished in a car accident. In the aftermath, the Fuyou family generously took him under their wing.

Then, on a red-letter day in June, his life took another turn. Both Lisianthus, the Divine Princess, and Nerine, the Demon Princess, made a splash by transferring to his school. Suddenly, Rin found himself between a rock and a hard place, seen as a potential spouse for both princesses. This twist positioned him as "A man who can become a god, a demon, or an ordinary man." With the ball in his court, envy grew like wildfire among the male students who admired Fuyo Kaede, Lisianthus, and Nerine. Yet, Rin remained blissfully in the dark about his burgeoning popularity. Little did he know that clandestine photos of him were fetching prices worth their weight in gold on the black market.

In contrast to this chaotic social scene, Rin's character shone brightly. He always went the extra mile for others, placing their needs above his own. He'd jump through hoops to support those around him and despised showing his cards by appearing vulnerable.

However, at home, it was a different ball game. Rin was like a fish out of water regarding domestic tasks. Here, Kaede pulled the strings, managing chores and often playing the role of the early bird, waking up the ever-tardy Rin.
"I'm confident that no one can beat my endurance."

Sia, for short; she is the only daughter of the King of the Gods. The single memory of her childhood meeting with Rin has brought her to the Human world. Bright and energetic, her outgoing personality lets her talk at ease with anyone she meets and quickly sets the mood in conversation. She is good at housework and sports, but studying isn't her forte. She is also known to beat her father with a chair from time to time if he gets out of control.
from MangaGamer

Rin, for short, is the only daughter of the King of the Devils. Like Lisianthus, the memories of her childhood with Rin have brought her to the Human world. She is proper, modest, and reserved, but she won't hesitate to release her offensive magic when someone makes a fool out of Rin. She also possesses a beautiful voice, dubbed "Angel's Bell," but she dislikes singing.
In her route's sequel, Tick Tack!, Nerine can be potentially subjected to changes in personality, physical features, and memory due to Rin's interference in the past era before her birth.
from MangaGamer
Rin's childhood friend and classmate.
Kaede's mother passed away in the same accident that claimed both Rin's parents; they've lived under the same roof since then.
She is an ideal woman—brilliant, athletic, attractive, and capable in the home—and one-third of the male students at her school worship her. Still, she prioritizes Rin over and above herself.

Kaede was crowned "Miss Verbena" at last year's cultural festival. Furthermore, after the arrival of the devil and god princesses, Sia and Nerine, she has also taken on the title of "Princess of the Human World."
Edited from Wikipedia

Asa is a third-year student at Verbena Academy in the class 3-B. She is in the cooking club with Kaede. As a result, Asa and Rin share a love-hate relationship (though they're more like a bad company to each other). She is responsible and diligent, but also cheerful and quick to join in. However, she also has a lesser-known tendency to depend on others.
Asa has no fan club, unlike Kaede, but there are many hidden fans. She placed on 8th at last year's cultural festival event "Miss Verbena." (Kaede is in the 1st place).
For some reason, she despises the existence of magic and gets angry just by talking about the supernatural powers.
Although she secretly in love with Rin, she didn't show her feeling due to the presence of Kaede and the Princesses.
Her mother, Ama Shigure, was the first experiment of the Yggdrasil project.
from MangaGamer
Primula is the third experimental subject and the first homunculus developed from the ground up as part of a collaborative effort between the Divine and Demon Realms.

To meet "Rin," whom Nerine had often told her about in the demon realm, she escaped and came to the human world. The Fuyou family cared for her since she insisted on staying with Rin. Primula is a lovely girl with a doll-like complexion, and despite her childlike appearance, she is only one year younger than Rin.

While possessing the most potent magical power, Primula has little control. She could quickly annihilate one of the prefectures if she is not cautious. Likewise, the young lady doesn't know much about things other than magic, so she can't express her feelings properly.
Her favorite food is cheesecake.

Kareha is a god who is Asa's friend and classmate; consequently, the two are often seen together. She has a catchphrase of saying "Maa! Maa!! Maa!!!" (translated "My!! My!! My!!!") whenever she sees something romantic or cute, and starts to daydream. She works a part time job as a waitress in the cafe that Rin and the other characters visit frequently.
from Wikipedia
Mayumi is a human-devil hybrid who is Kaede and Rin’s classmate.
A curious person and rushes into anything and often becomes a troublemaker. She always carried a digital camera around to satisfy her curiosity.
She is a pretty and stylish girl; however, she has an inferiority complex related to her chests that are even smaller than Primula's.
Her grades are so low that she joins supplementary classes regularly, but she is quite knowledgeable about trivial matters. Mayumi is also a skilled negotiator.
The homeroom teacher of Rin's class in charge of worlds history (the worlds here refer to the "human world," the "divine world," and the "demon world").

Nadeshiko is a passionate teacher who loves honesty, perseverance, hard work, and friendship. In addition, she is not only strict but also flexible depending on the situation. She has the guts to hold her own against the Divine and the Demon King when the situation demands it.

Despite the fact that she is a teacher, Nadeshiko was named third runner-up in the "Miss Verbena" event at the school festival last year. Because of her looks and personality, she is very popular among the students. She addresses all of her students by their first names except Rin, whom she calls as "Tsuchii."

It seems that she has been picked up hundreds of times, and she doesn't budge even when the Demon King tries to seduce her. It is no exaggeration to say that her hobbies are to measure men's value. Ironically, however, she has no romantic experience and is naive.

Lisianthus's father and the lord of the realm of the gods. He is big, musclebound, and enjoys drinking sake. Despite his best intentions, he often embarrasses his daughter, and it is a running gag in the series that she frequently has to hit him with a chair in order to calm him down.
from Wikipedia

Nerine's father and the lord of the realm of the devils. He is lecherous and thus quickly gets along with Itsuki at the beginning of the game. Like the King of Gods, he too has a habit of embarrassing his daughter, which usually leads to Nerine addressing him as "King of Devils" instead of "Father" as punishment.
Edited from Wikipedia

Itsuki Midoriba is Rin's "bad" friend and classmate. Being the womanizer of the class, he is envious of the girls' attraction to Rin and often mentions that he will look after the girls Rin does not pick.
Edited from Wikipedia
Ama Shigure is Asa's mother.

She has the habit of drastically reducing names to cute nicknames (Asa for instance is referred to as "A-chan"). She also wears a cat-ear hat. She looks abnormally young to be a mother, and it surprises the other characters to learn that she is quite a bit older than she looks.
Edited from Wikipedia
Sage is Forbesii's maid. In the standard timeline, she marries him and is Nerine's mother.

Sage is very energetic and cheerful in almost all circumstances. She is an excellent housemaker and good at hiding her feeling, especially towards Forbesii, to whom her whole heart is dedicated. However, since Forbesii is a prince and she is just his maid, Sage tries to provide services to Forbesii and devotes her life to it in the hope that she may not have to leave him when he ties the knot with his fiancee, Ai.

In one possible timeline, Rin may decide to engage in sexual and romantic relations with Sage, thus changing the future mother of Nerine. Rin will be forced to reject Sage when she asks him who he would choose as a partner - Nerine or Sage. Sage will then admit she will later cry over the fact Rin is leaving her behind. A red-haired Nerine will replace the original blue-haired one if Rin chooses this path.
Edited from Wikipedia
Cineraria is the younger sister of Forbesii, one of the wives of Eustoma, and the mother of Lisianthus. She carries around a chair to hit people like Lisianthus does.
From Wikipedia
Bark is Forbesii's butler and is very devoted to him.
Kaede and Rin’s mutual childhood friend; a modest and calm girl.

She’s sensitive to the mood around her and good at listening to the troubles of others but is a lost cause when it comes to herself. She gets flustered and panics. At present, she attends a different academy from the two of them.
from MangaGamer
Ruri is s a member of Sia's personal guard from the Realm of Gods.
She prefers wearing the boys' uniform over the girls' one. Outwardly she seems very cold, but she's actually got a pleasant and serene personality.
Edited from Wikipedia
Kareha's younger sister. Mentioned in Shuffle! she becomes a side character in Shuffle! On the Stage and a winable heroine in Shuffle! Essence+
Introduced in Shuffle Essence+ her origins and relationship to Rin and the girls are a mystery. She tries to get the others to join the broadcast club.
A boy who appears in a lot of Navel and Basil games, and mischievously lifts the skirts of the heroines.
adapted from Danbooru Wiki
Mikio is Kaede's father and the husband of Momiji Fuyou. His only appearance in the visual novels is as a secondary character in Really? Really!.
From Wikipedia
